entries.3e80bd4f5aabd1ab: Retail of Meat and Other Products
entries.4d6500db2897d729: Segment information (overview of reportable segments, amounts by reportable segment, related information including information by region and by major customer), status of affiliated companies
entries.512db8f909c6cb81: Major meat wholesalers whose main business is the production and wholesale of meat and processed products, including its parent company S FOODS Inc., are shareholders, and it has an equity-method affiliate, Fūdorie Co., Ltd., which manufactures processed meat products. It explains that it is in a position to secure merchandise along the flow from production areas to consumers, and that, as each meat store basically processes products in-store, it can provide fresh products responsive to customer needs.
entries.5ab8df626dbe0dce: Meat and related retail and restaurant business
entries.6c3881418f21a83d: A holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, which, together with six subsidiaries, two affiliates and one parent company (nine affiliated companies in total), forms the group. Its main business is retail sales of meat and other food products, and it also runs a restaurant business. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended January 2026 numbered 753.
entries.84deb1b15d07afdc: Through subsidiaries, the company sells meat, processed meat products and prepared foods at retail stores and also operates yakiniku restaurants and steak restaurants, earning payment for those sales.
entries.892e4d32de9cac65: Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥35,371 million. Revenue was ¥24,850 million for the meat and related retail business and ¥10,520 million for the restaurant business.
entries.933b16d6faf66fa0: This business conducts retail of meat and processed meat products and retail of prepared dishes. The subsidiaries OM Two Meat Co., Ltd., Maruchou Kobeya Co., Ltd. and Ota Sogo Shokuhin Co., Ltd. process and sell meat and processed meat products to general consumers. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥24,850 million, and the number of stores at the end of the consolidated fiscal year was 150 (140 meat retail stores and 10 prepared dish retail stores).
entries.96a484ae03e67db8: The reportable segments are two: the meat and related retail business (revenue from external customers ¥24,850 million) and the restaurant business (¥10,520 million). Information by region is omitted, and no major customer information is disclosed because no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of revenue. Its parent company, S FOODS Inc., holds 53.9% of the company’s voting rights.
entries.98c6d935e0c71980: It purchases merchandise from meat manufacturers and wholesalers, including its parent company, S FOODS Inc. The company and its subsidiaries also sell products to S FOODS Inc.
entries.9a0a8e9b01048885: Revenue from merchandise sales in the meat and related retail business
entries.9c9abf30087af436: It sells products to general consumers through its stores and provides meals. As of January 31, 2026, the meat and related retail business had 150 stores and the restaurant business had 47 stores.
entries.abf9fe65b871252c: The basic management policy is “customer-first,” which pursues customer satisfaction under the social mission of “creating vibrant individuals and contributing to the improvement of food culture.” Medium to long term, the company positions as its core the business of operating meat retail stores as tenants, aims to become Japan’s largest meat retail store group, and identifies the restaurant business, a meat-related business close to consumers, as an area to strengthen. It also plans to expand into businesses that can be expected to create synergies with its meat-related business.

entries.d663b7cd4b39998a: A holding company under S Foods that operates meat specialty retail stores and yakiniku and steak restaurants.
entries.d8dc484ecddea5dc: Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥35,371 million, up 7.9% year on year. The MD&A explains that the restaurant business benefited from inbound and large corporate party demand, and from the effects of Ōta Sōgō Shokuhin Co., Ltd., whose consolidation period was short in the previous fiscal year, and Yūwa Co., Ltd., which was not consolidated in the previous fiscal year.
entries.d98483658e0a8edf: Subsidiaries purchase merchandise from Fūdorie Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate.
entries.df6a7bf47cfcd1a1: Subsidiaries process and sell meat, processed meat products and prepared foods at retail stores, and also operate yakiniku and shabu-shabu restaurants and steak restaurants.

entries.f741a99e7ecb59c9: The company is a holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, which forms a group with 6 subsidiaries and 2 associated companies; its parent company is S FOODS Inc. Consolidated headcount for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was 753.
entries.f816c8ed3ae31f11: This business operates yakiniku restaurants and steak restaurants. The subsidiaries Yakiniku no Gyuta Co., Ltd. and Yuwa Co., Ltd. operate yakiniku and shabu-shabu restaurants for general consumers, and OM Two Dining Co., Ltd. operates steak restaurants. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥10,520 million, and the number of stores at the end of the consolidated fiscal year was 47.
